headline: Google Cloud London outage disrupts UK banks, courts and other services
summary: A Google Cloud outage centered on its London region, later attributed to a power event, disrupted banks including Lloyds, HSBC and Revolut, along with UK courts and other services. Google apologised and said services were being restored, though regulators are seeking details about what caused the widespread disruption.
